staff.name: Hannah Gilbert
staff.basis: The staffing model puts 1 of this role in a millinery or dressmaking room at the typical band and 2 at the high end, on period_convention. The needle trades ran on assistants and the 1835 notices advertise for them. Analogue: the 1839 list's six milliners and its tailoresses, and the 1840 column that has no row for them at all. This person is a reconstructed resident of the trade with no workplace of their own; the house is one the business layer already holds, and this row points at it rather than raising anything. staff.replaceable_by: a source naming where this person worked, which retires the draw
